title: Corpus-wide default-key OutGuess calibration

target.description: Whether any LP2 page separates from the repeated false-header distribution under the frozen default-key OutGuess 0.13 path

summary: Only the ten known LP1 positive controls separated. No tested LP2 page produced a non-attractor header, familywise anomaly, or detector-positive extraction under the frozen default-key OutGuess path.
why_run: To determine whether earlier complete LP2 OutGuess outputs were genuine page-specific embeddings or capacity-threshold completions of a repeated false-header attractor.

parameters.detector_rule: complete AND (non-FFFFFFFF header OR minimum familywise p <= 0.05)

pipeline.description: Verify the complete retained page and extraction ledgers, independent-retrieval agreement, false-header family counts, held-out control, false controls, LP2 familywise tests, and bounded branch-closing decision.

acceptance.criterion: Only known LP1 controls separate; no LP2 page is a detector positive or familywise matched-null anomaly under the frozen test.

output.stdout: PASS — 13/13 normalized E1059 evidence checks; active LP2 default-key OutGuess leads: none.

controls: Ten historically positive LP1 carriers, with Page 08 held out from detector construction.
Six frozen LP2 false controls: Pages 17, 18, 20, 21, 22, and 43.
8,191 page-specific conditional randomizations with Bonferroni correction over 225 predeclared tests.
Independent retrieval records agree on all 75 headers, seeds, lengths, offsets, and output hashes.
No alternative keys, carrier transformations, or post-hoc decoding rules were admitted.
interpretation: The repeated FFFFFFFF header and complete 58,152-byte LP2 outputs are capacity-bound artifacts under this exact path, not supported page-specific payload extractions. The tested default-key lane is retained only as a regression and carrier-provenance control.
limitations: This closes only OutGuess 0.13 with its default-key path on the declared canonical carriers; it does not close other keys, carrier variants, tools, or steganography generally.
The normalized package distributes carrier identities, hashes, complete ledgers, controls, and source, but not the 75 JPEG files or large coefficient bitmaps.
The portable verifier reproduces the ledger checks and conclusion; full coefficient extraction therefore remains outside this package and the reproduction status is PARTIAL.
The result recovers no LP2 plaintext, key, locator, endpoint, or Page 73 preimage.

normalization_changes: Converted the historical result into the HMS Run and Result schemas.
Retained all 75 extraction ledgers, the complete detector ledger, controls, source hashes, and independent-retrieval crosscheck.
Added a portable non-mutating standard-library verifier because the historical verifier used a fixed Linux path and an incorrect ledger-directory name.
Excluded canonical JPEG carriers, large coefficient bitmaps, known-positive output bodies, and unrelated forward workbench material.

raw_artifacts.reason: The complete quantitative evidence for the bounded public claim is retained; large carrier inputs and decoded control bodies are represented by identities and hashes rather than redistributed bytes.
